citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:45AM on
8/20/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee/registrant by calling and the licensee stated they were out of
town and unavailable for inspection.. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Makayla Willis, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
